class.name: IfcPreDefinedCurveFont
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : The predefined curve font type is an abstract supertype provided to define an application specific curve font. The name label shall be constrained in the application protocol to values that are given specific meaning for curve fonts in that application protocol. NOTE: The IfcPreDefinedCurveFont is an abstract entity, subtypes of it provide the predefined curv
